svg.title: Тяга нижнего блока широким хватом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Conventional seated wide-grip low cable row, side-front camera. Upright seated athlete on a low bench with both soles fixed against foot plates. A single wide straight handle is held overhand with hands farther apart than shoulders. A single cable connects its midpoint to the bottom pulley located a little above floor and visibly well below hands, in both phases. Start arms reach forward; finish both elbows bend back and to sides, bringing bar close to lower chest. Use matching straight bar and single connected cable in both views, no standing or lifting from floor. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
